notes: The package contains the current-engine r35 item bridge, exact inventory-slot replacement, typed skill/item fields, bulk elephant actions, and target/immediate/point direct effects.
The 3.0 skill and item field routes use batched current-engine native callbacks with identity checks and readback validation.
The 3.0 bulk elephant routes cover local healing, local cooldown reset, selected-owner kill, and peace mode.
Live r35 item write was not claimed because the available game session was not in a stable map/selection state.
Cross-device validation remains pending and must be performed on the other machine.
Buff-constructor direct effects, create-all-loaded-items, and several legacy-only elephant actions remain outside the current-engine route.
